_note: Evals use bundled synthetic fixtures (see files/make_fixtures.py) rather than nilearn.datasets fetchers, because Anthropic's sandbox blocks the CDN hosts the fetchers download from. End users with normal internet should use the built-in fetchers — the skill recommends them by default.

evals.name: glm_first_level_block_design
evals.prompt: I have a small task-fMRI dataset and I want to fit a first-level GLM. The BOLD file is at evals/files/glm/bold.nii.gz with TR=7s, the events are in evals/files/glm/events.tsv (a single trial type called 'active' in a block design), and there's a brain mask at evals/files/glm/brain_mask.nii.gz. Please fit the model, compute the contrast for 'active' vs baseline, save the z-map and a glass-brain visualization to ./results_glm/, and tell me what z-range you saw. Also generate an HTML report.
evals.expected_output: A working FirstLevelModel fit on the provided fixture, with t_r=7 set explicitly, the 'active' contrast computed and saved as a NIfTI, glass-brain PNG saved, HTML report saved, and a written summary that includes the actual z-range observed.
expectations: Reads bold.nii.gz from evals/files/glm/ (does not invent a different path or call a nilearn dataset fetcher)
Loads events.tsv as a DataFrame with onset, duration, trial_type columns
Instantiates FirstLevelModel with t_r=7.0 (or 7) explicitly
Calls .fit() on the model with the bold image and events
Calls .compute_contrast('active', ...) (or equivalent) and gets a z-map
Saves at least one .nii.gz file to ./results_glm/
Saves at least one .png file (e.g., glass brain or stat map) to ./results_glm/
Generates an HTML report (e.g., via make_glm_report)
Reports the actual z-range in the response text (not a placeholder)
Uses standardize=False (or omits it; the default is False for FirstLevelModel) and not the deprecated 'True' value for any maskers used

evals.name: connectivity_three_subjects_correlation
evals.prompt: I have 3 subjects of resting-state fMRI in evals/files/connectivity/ — files are sub-01_bold.nii.gz, sub-02_bold.nii.gz, sub-03_bold.nii.gz with TR=2s and matching sub-XX_confounds.tsv files. There's a 6-region label atlas at evals/files/connectivity/atlas.nii.gz with names in atlas_labels.csv. Extract timeseries for each subject (use the confounds), compute correlation matrices, and give me a mean matrix heatmap plus a glass-brain connectome. Output to ./connectivity_out/.
evals.expected_output: Three-subject correlation pipeline: NiftiLabelsMasker built from atlas.nii.gz with t_r=2 and bandpass filter set, timeseries extracted for each subject with their matching confounds, a correlation matrix per subject, a mean matrix, a heatmap PNG, and a connectome glass-brain PNG.
expectations: Uses NiftiLabelsMasker (not NiftiMapsMasker — atlas is deterministic labels)
Constructs masker with t_r=2.0 explicitly
Constructs masker with standardize='zscore_sample' (the string, not deprecated True)
Sets low_pass and high_pass on the masker (or filters before extraction)
Loads each subject's matching confounds TSV and passes to fit_transform
Uses ConnectivityMeasure with kind='correlation'
Produces 3 timeseries arrays of shape (150, 6) (or fit_transform on a list)
Computes a per-subject and a mean connectivity matrix
Saves a matrix heatmap PNG to ./connectivity_out/
Saves a glass-brain connectome PNG using plot_connectome with coords
Mean matrix shows strong positive correlation between regions 1-2 and 3-4, negative between 5-6 (the known structure in the fixture)

evals.name: decoding_face_vs_house_leave_one_run_out
evals.prompt: Run an MVPA decoding analysis: the 4D BOLD is at evals/files/decoding/bold.nii.gz where each volume is one trial (TR=2s). Labels and run numbers are in evals/files/decoding/labels.csv (columns 'labels' with 'face'/'house', 'chunks' with run number 0-5). Use the VT mask at evals/files/decoding/vt_mask.nii.gz, SVC classifier, and leave-one-run-out cross-validation. Tell me the mean accuracy across folds and how it compares to chance. Save the weight map as a NIfTI and a plot to ./decoder_out/.
evals.expected_output: Decoder pipeline with SVC, LeaveOneGroupOut CV on the run variable, fit on the VT mask, accuracy reported with chance level (0.5), weight map saved as NIfTI and PNG.
expectations: Loads labels.csv and uses the 'labels' column as y and 'chunks' as groups
Uses nilearn.decoding.Decoder (not raw sklearn) with estimator='svc'
Uses LeaveOneGroupOut from sklearn.model_selection (or equivalent group CV)
Passes groups=chunks to decoder.fit()
Uses the vt_mask.nii.gz as the mask= argument (not whole brain)
Uses standardize='zscore_sample' (not deprecated True)
Reports mean accuracy in the response text
Reports the chance level (0.5 for binary) in the response text
Saves the weight map as a .nii.gz in ./decoder_out/
Saves a plot of the weight map as PNG in ./decoder_out/
